_comment: FASTER BALL (condition, not a downstream fudge). tactical-flow had slowed ground passes to 30/28/26/26/28/28 km/h, which made balls EASIER to control and worked against the looseness brief. This restores Konami stock 36/34/32/32/34/34 km/h: a faster arriving ball exceeds the receiver controllable-speed threshold more often, so the trap difficulty term D fires - which is where first-touch looseness should come from.
